summary: MeTube provides a web-based user interface for managing video downloads through youtube-dl and its forks. It supports batch queuing and playlist retrieval from a wide range of supported video-sharing platforms.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want a simple, browser-accessible queue for archiving video content without using the command line.
watchOut: Upstream video platforms frequently alter their site structures, requiring regular updates to the underlying download engine to prevent breakage.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure persistent volume storage to retain your downloaded media and handle proxy headers properly if placing the web interface behind a TLS terminator.
